Structure fixed at the same time: the six sections are now six nodes (the parser had read the Form VIII witness lines and Forms X/XI as sections numbered 1 and 2); the substituted 32(1) and inserted 32(1A), (1B), (3), 33(1A), (2A), (4) sit under the limb that enacts them; the three Forms are form nodes under section 5.
Printed peculiarities kept as printed: s.3 limb (4) 'iterest'; Form VIII authority note '[section 32(b)]'; s.4's full stop after the closing quotation mark.
Dotted blanks in the Forms are reproduced approximately; their exact length is not significant.
